tooltips.rxnavEngine: Queries live US National Library of Medicine (NIH RxNav) interaction database & FDA official drug labels in real time.
tooltips.pingPatient: Sends an instant loud audio alarm to the patient's device in real-time to prompt them to take their missed dose.
tooltips.dosingConsiderations: Evidence-based dosing adjustments (PDR.net) screened against the patient's documented chronic conditions (e.g. Renal/Kidney failure).
tooltips.hardLock: Strict safety mechanism that disables the prescribe button when Major/Severe interactions are detected.
tooltips.rxcuiCode: Standardized Concept Unique Identifier by the National Library of Medicine for universal drug interoperability.
tooltips.pdrMonograph: Prescribers' Digital Reference official summary including dosing, indications, contraindications and adverse reactions.
